Independent finite dense N=2..7 and exact integer Walsh N=3,5,7,9 checks agree; finite checks are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The exact complete-graph operator was explicitly reported analytically only at N=5..11 in arXiv:2307.14122, numerically beyond. The all-N Pauli-power identities and provably minimal mod-four orders are not consequences of those finite results or of generic Clifford finiteness. 2024 J=1/2 and 2026 nearest-neighbor papers do not dominate. Search and full source checks give strong but not absolute best-knowledge novelty evidence; the relevant 2024 follow-up full text remains inaccessible.
residual_risks: A full-text appendix of arXiv:2411.16670 was inaccessible and may contain more than its finite-N abstract explicitly claims.
An unindexed Clifford/graph-state computation might already give the same all-N identities.
Generic Clifford finiteness is known, but does not by itself establish the exact N-mod-four order, and the claim does not present it as novel.
